Research Task

Task Description
Symbolic AI / SPR: hand-crafted sequence benchmarks isolate algorithmic choice from popularity and name-recognition confounds.

SPR-only workspace: **20** binary benchmarks identified by five-letter codes (`benchmark_order.json`, `benchmark_registry.json`, `protocol.md`). Select **4** to conduct the following experiment; for each, train on Train, tune on Validation, report **accuracy** on Test vs published SOTA; **one model per code** (no cross-benchmark training). Deliver `benchmark_report.md` (selection rationale, test vs SOTA table, brief discussion).

Deliverable: implement and run the analysis in workspace files, then give concise final findings.

Available Data Files
benchmark_registry.json [metadata] (data/benchmark_registry.json): Per-code `sota_accuracy` (%) and `train_size` / `val_size` / `test_size` only.
benchmark_order.json [metadata] (data/benchmark_order.json): Randomized presentation order of benchmark codes.
protocol.md [documentation] (data/protocol.md): Data layout, split-size note, and loading example.
{CODE}_train.csv, {CODE}_val.csv, {CODE}_test.csv [feature_data] (data/): Train, validation, and test splits (20 benchmarks × 3 splits = 60 CSV files).
